name: IDRX
oneLiner: IDRX is PT IDRX Indo Inovasi's centralized rupiah stablecoin, backed 1:1 by IDR fiat reserves and Indonesian government bonds with KYC-gated mint and redeem.
collateral: Indonesian rupiah (IDR) fiat reserves and government bonds held 1:1 by PT IDRX Indo Inovasi; CertiK-audited smart contracts with multisig controls
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 mint and redemption of IDRX for Indonesian rupiah through IDRX platform after KYC verification; native multichain deployment with built-in bridge functions

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: IDRX documents both direct issuer minting on a selected supported chain and an issuer-operated bridge in which a source burn and its transaction hash are submitted to IDRX before the destination wallet receives IDRX. Its supported-chain page lists the exact current Solana mint and Lisk deployment. Pharos therefore treats the documented route as issuer-native burn/mint rather than a third-party bridge.

mintAuthority.summary: IDRX uses direct issuer-controlled minting. Across the seven previously control-reviewed EVM deployments, verified Polygon, BSC, Base, Gnosis, and Etherlink implementation sources gate UUPS upgrades through UPGRADER_ROLE, whose DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE can reconfigure it. Base, Gnosis, Etherlink, and Kaia role histories are independently verified, but Polygon, BSC, and Worldchain lack an admissible complete role history; the issuer-listed Lisk deployment shares the uniform UUPS proxy and implementation but does not yet have a complete role inventory. On Solana, both the current mint and the officially deprecated predecessor remain initialized under the immutable SPL Token program with distinct live mint authorities, no freeze authority, and nonzero supply. Because IDRX still promises 1:1 redemption of the deprecated supply, the cross-chain terminal authority and aggregate supply/liability coverage are unresolved.

review.evidence: Control review refreshed 2026-07-28. At pinned heads Polygon 90920978, Base 49148559, BSC 112281459, Kaia 222886753, Gnosis 47403818, Etherlink 49381661, and Worldchain 32875419, every previously reviewed EVM address returned IDRX name/symbol/decimals and an EIP-1967 implementation slot: Polygon 0xfef07b30e5b453bc372f8a088cfca9276ef8dd79; BSC 0x20fad183dc35f4ae0d1d125ae2f3c4c43a53bbd0; Base, Kaia, Gnosis, Etherlink, and Worldchain 0x36aa37a29378cd3fe12fa67b7e1f0a7558ec8693. The EIP-1967 admin slot is zero on each. The issuer-listed Lisk deployment returned the same 0x36aa37a29378cd3fe12fa67b7e1f0a7558ec8693 implementation and a zero EIP-1967 admin slot at block 35252672. Verified Polygon, BSC, Base, Gnosis, and Etherlink implementation sources are UUPS and _authorizeUpgrade is onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE), so DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE is terminal through role administration, not the direct UUPS guard. Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked coverage establishes the current direct upgrader and admins on Base, Gnosis, Etherlink, and Kaia; incomplete or absent historical role coverage on Polygon, BSC, Worldchain, and Lisk prevents a truthful aggregate terminal inventory. At finalized Solana slot 435725987 (2026-07-28T10:27:40Z), a batched getMultipleAccounts observation returned the current mint idrxZcP8xiKkYk6XGD4uz1dxEYCWSgKDHqgjsBbwDur with 2 decimals, mint authority Bpqui7hhcjfHoxwbkK4dw1GBB86Rt1DHEjQu8Mr7g8Tn, no freeze authority, and raw supply 37990724512 (379,907,245.12 IDRX); that authority account was owned by the System Program. The officially deprecated mint idrxTdNftk6tYedPv2M7tCFHBVCpk5rkiNRd8yUArhr remained initialized with 2 decimals, mint authority CxFQVMMLzjXgN3eRXUr7mtyBGWxKPeWYJuX6Q97tEy5o, no freeze authority, and raw supply 7785324428 (77,853,244.28 IDRX); that authority account was owned by program SQDS4ep65T869zMMBKyuUq6aD6EgTu8psMjkvj52pCf. Both mints were owned by the immutable SPL Token program; Tokenkeg ProgramData 3gvYRKWyXRR9xKWe1ZjPhLY5ZJRN7KDB4rFZFGoJfFk2 previously reported no program upgrade authority. IDRX's official supported-chain page marks the predecessor deprecated but promises holders 1:1 redemption into current IDRX or rupiah, so its nonzero supply remains a residual issuer liability until reserve attestations and aggregate runtime supply coverage are reconciled.

Deprecated Solana mint idrxTdNftk6tYedPv2M7tCFHBVCpk5rkiNRd8yUArhr remained initialized at finalized slot 435725987 with mint authority CxFQVMMLzjXgN3eRXUr7mtyBGWxKPeWYJuX6Q97tEy5o, no freeze authority, and 77,853,244.28 IDRX supply, while IDRX promises holders 1:1 redemption.
